CaseManager$new()

Initialize a CaseManager object.

Usage

CaseManager$new(
  caseLst = NULL,
  pattern = getOption("ugrid.pattern"),
  crs = NA_character_,
  newCrs = NA_character_,
  ignoreCrsInFile = FALSE
)

Arguments

caseLst

Character vector of folder-paths of cases.

pattern

Regex pattern for listing NetCDF files.

crs

ID of the coordinate reference system used in the NetCDF. A number will be understood as an EPSG code. In case no information about CRS found in the NetCDF, this will be assigned as CRS for the dataset. It must have the length 1 (will be recycled) or the same length as caseLst.

newCrs

ID of a new coordinate reference system to transform the exported layers to.

ignoreCrsInFile

If TRUE, the CRS information in the NetCDF file will be ignored. Like crs, it must the length 1 (will be recycled) or the same length as caseLst also. A number will be also understood as an EPSG code.
